claimChecks.claim: Tessary is an open-source reliability platform for AI agents in production.
claimChecks.evidenceQuote: Tessary is an open-source reliability platform for AI agents in production.

claimChecks.claim: The system normalizes incoming traces to OpenTelemetry gen_ai.* conventions at the edge.
claimChecks.evidenceQuote: normalize to the OpenTelemetry gen_ai.* conventions at the edge.

claimChecks.claim: Classifiers continuously check traces and open a finding when a classifier fires.
claimChecks.evidenceQuote: Classifiers sweep every trace continuously and open a finding when one fires.

claimChecks.claim: Tessary investigates failing traces and optionally connected repository code.
claimChecks.evidenceQuote: RCA runs an agentic session over the failing traces and, when a repo is connected, the code itself.

claimChecks.claim: Tessary hands a case to a human and does not open the fix.
claimChecks.evidenceQuote: Tessary explains and hands off. It doesn't open the fix.
